summary_for_children: Al-Ma'arij means The Ascending Stairways. It speaks of patience and describes people who pray steadily and keep their trusts.
environment_concept: Garden steps rising gently and a quiet place of steady prayer (70:23); nothing unseen is shown.

areas.name: Stairways
areas.description: Abstract stairways of light; nothing unseen shown.

activities.name: Steady prayer
activities.description: Lay five numbered stones in order, steady and constant.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (lamps, steps, stones) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (design proposed from the Story Library; older composed scene exists; not built in the new engine)

primary_mechanic.text: Climb a tower where each floor is a habit from 70:22-35, unlocked by practising it.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Path of Patience
story_library.children_narration: People sometimes become impatient when things are difficult and selfish when things are easy. Surah Al-Ma'arij praises those who pray sincerely, care for people in need, and keep their promises. Good habits help us grow.

world_idea.title: The Tower of Good Habits
world_idea.description: Explore a distinctive vertical architectural environment where each level contains an activity about patience, generosity, trust, or responsibility.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
